newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PEN PICTURES OF FENERBAHCE PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PEN PICTURES OF FENERBAHCE PLAYERS.

text.p: Pen pictures of Fenerbahce players likely to feature in February 9 Turkish first division match against Galatasaray.

Fevzi Layic, goalkeeper, age 26. Second choice goalkeeper, replacement for international Rustu Recber who is on military service. Yet to fully prove himself, though generally regarded as reasonably trustworthy.
Ilker Yagcioglu, right back, age 30. Lightly-built defender with good ball skills who can also press into midfield when required.

Uche Okechukwu, right back, age 29. Powerful and skilful Nigerian defender. Uses his physique intelligently and distributes the ball sensibly from the back. Occasionally pushes forward to join the attack, where he gets to show-off his considerable flair and ease on the ball.

Jesse Hog, left back, age 30. Danish international who Fenerbahce fans have taken as one of their own. Forms the second half of the formidable partnership with Okechukwu at the heart of the Fenerbahce defence.

Erol Bulut, midfielder, age 21. Had a difficult start to the season, when his place was under threat. But reacted well and his competitive nature and good crossing skills have earned him a regular place in the starting line-up.

Selahattin Ozbir, midfielder, age 21. Young hopeful who has broken into the first team in the second half of the season. Though a member of the Turkish national squad, he has yet to win a cap. Great things expected.

Mustafa Dogan, midfielder, age 20. Turk who grew up in Germany, where he played for the German national youth team. Plays in front of defence and distributes superbly. Highly regarded by both fans and pundits, thought to have a bright future.

Augustine "Jay Jay" Okocha, striker, age 23. Strong, fast, Nigerian international front man. Excellent ball control and superb turns, make him the most entertaining man on the pitch. A nightmare for goalkeepers from long-range free-kicks.

Tayfun Korkut, midfielder, age 23. Back in the team at last after a long spell of injury, Fenerbahce missed him in the first half of the season. Plays on the right wing, but has the ability to both make and score goals.

Elvir Bolic, striker, age 25. Bosnian star who can and will shoot from any angle, any distance and has the pace and the skill to get through the tightest defence. Has scored vital matchwinning goals this season including those against Manchester United in Europe and for Bosnia in its famous victory over against Italy.

Saffet Sancakli, striker, age 30. Started at Kocaelispor, where he returned after an unsatisfactory spell at Galatasaray. Brought to Fenerbahce to form an attacking partnership with Bolic, so far with mixed results.
